name: Pixel Art Screen Quad Shader
instruction: In scenes/main.tscn, add a MeshInstance2D named ScreenQuad that uses a QuadMesh sized 1280x720 and is positioned at (640, 360). Create a ShaderMaterial for it that uses a new shader at assets/shaders/pixel_art.gdshader. The shader must sample the screen texture with filter_nearest, downsample SCREEN_UV to a target_resolution of 320x180, quantize colors using a colors_per_channel value of 8, and output the quantized color. Set the material shader parameters to target_resolution = Vector2(320, 180) and colors_per_channel = 8.0.

metadata.tutorial_source: YouTube: DevPoodle - Making a 3D Pixel Art Shader Effect - Using Godot Engine
metadata.transcript_excerpt: add a mesh instance... add in a basic quad mesh... the same resolution 1280 by 720... offset the x value by half... create a new Shader material... Shader... add a new uniform for the screen texture... hint screen texture... downscale... target resolution 320x180... add colors per channel... replace with quantized color... add filter nearest
